description: The Overview, Roles and Users tabs on a phone: Access Roles' dashboard page at 375x812 with touch (pointer: coarse) and jellyfin-web's mobile layout, as admin, reading only. On each of these tabs (Overview, Roles, Users; the other tabs are accessroles-admin-tabs-phone.json's) nothing is past the screen's right edge (the status tables' long values wrap) and the page doesn't scroll sideways, and every button, checkbox row and select is at least 44 px tall; the users' rows wrap; the probe's 100-character role name (one unbroken word after "Page probe ") wraps inside the screen on the Roles tab, in its editor's title and in the panel's role list; the dialogs' Close icon is 44 px both ways and their text fields 44 px tall; pageprobe-teen's panel is a sheet no wider than the screen whose controls are 44 px tall too, closed with its Close button. accessroles-admin-page-probe.mjs gives pageprobe-teen the probe's lock-only role "Page probe Guest" first, and makes the long-named lock-only role nobody has.

steps.name: the module mounted: the tabs, the status loaded, the loading note hidden
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('#AccessRolesConfigPage:not(.hide)'); return !!p && p.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]').length === 8 && p.querySelectorAll('#AccessRolesStatus table').length === 5 && p.querySelector('#AccessRolesScriptNote').hidden === true; })()
